scientific_question: Can held-out causal contradictions produce a non-vacuous ground-truth-free lower bound on CDFM graph error?
formal_target: ground-truth-free minimum structural repair / graph-error lower-bound certification

data.split: first 500 rows discovery, last 500 rows validation; standardization fit on discovery only
data.dev_source: Gate-5A manifest, raw CDFM predictions and validation data, all read-only

rr_ci.statements: local Markov statements for every candidate node
rr_ci.multiple_testing: Holm over all local-Markov statements per task

rr_anm.assumption: Y=f(Pa_candidate(Y))+epsilon with epsilon independent of candidate non-descendants when the parent set is correct
rr_anm.tested_variables: all candidate non-descendants other than Y, including candidate parents
rr_anm.validation_split: deterministic 250/250 A/B split from graph seed
rr_anm.residual_test: RCIT residual versus one tested non-descendant, unconditional
rr_anm.multiple_testing: Holm over all atomic (Y,Z,Pa_candidate(Y)) witnesses per task

repair.distance: directed pairwise SHD; add, delete, or reverse one unordered-pair state costs one
repair.space: DAGs on the same ten observed nodes
repair.search: exhaustive pair-state enumeration with DAG pruning for k=0,1,2,3
repair.ci_witness_persists: repaired DAG d-separates the tested pair given the fixed candidate conditioning set
repair.anm_witness_persists: repaired DAG has the same candidate parent set for Y and Z remains a non-descendant of Y

evaluation.truth: opened only after phase pre-truth hashes
evaluation.validity: RR_CI and RR_ANM lower bounds do not exceed true SHD
evaluation.tightness: RR / true SHD for true SHD > 0
evaluation.paired_gain: RR_ANM severe RR>=2 rate minus RR_CI severe RR>=2 rate

gate.dev_failure: any DEV condition fails: stop before independent FINAL
gate.borderline: validity passes but an efficacy condition fails
gate.inconclusive: technical failure rate exceeds 10 percent or an evaluation denominator is empty
